counterexamples.finding: TestRollback.test_rollback_pointer_is_a_real_git_commit is vacuous with respect to the product rollback pointer.
counterexamples.quote: baseline = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "log", "--format=%H", "--reverse"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split(); self.assertTrue(baseline, "a baseline commit must exist for rollback"); self.assertEqual(dirty_check.returncode, 0)
counterexamples.reason: It asserts only that this checkout has history and git status runs successfully. It never reads, resolves, or validates the product's rollback pointer. An invalid product rollback target would not affect these assertions.

counterexamples.finding: Ten atoms retain full clause copies despite successful de-duplication checking.
counterexamples.example: REQ-17aaa2060430cfc8016f: atom source_clause.text and sources[SRC-8f7d7af7b4673fd8bef7].text both equal 系統交付發行說明.
counterexamples.qualification: Removing source_text fields is a real structural change, and fixture requirements remain recoverable. It does not establish the stronger claim that no atom embeds a byte-identical clause copy; actual PI serialized size increases by 633 bytes against HEAD.

evidence_gaps: The full suite, golden pilots, CLI qualification and exact strict web/host commands were not executed because they write files.
The exact technology --report command's non-zero exit was not observed; its pure computations and return logic were independently inspected instead.

Crosswalk --check uses an unavailable /src-ro blueprint path and accepts absent upstream text. The corresponding local Windows blueprint was available and independently checked, so actual candidate locator verification did not rely on that fallback.
Presence of an oracle file is weaker than proving that it exercises every behavior claimed by its crosswalk row.
No danger-full-access match in R4 raw files is not proof of each writer's actual execution permissions.
The secret scan found no confirmed credential but does not prove absence of every possible secret format or secrets inside compressed payloads.
residual_risks: Publication validation can pass against older subjects while omitting newly introduced R4 product files.
Performance thresholds can be exceeded without a failing process exit.
The de-duplication checker can pass after losing a requirement atom.
Source-pin admission remains a hard FAIL at 0/22; no technology is independently source-pinned.
Host integration evidence is fixture/mock only.
perf_budget.py reports candidate_head=UNBOUND_NO_GIT_BINARY although git is available and was successfully used during this audit.
